_provenance: Planet surface rung — consumes solar system planet triples (mass, a, e). The Mirror of Erised is encoded as a hard wall: at least one habitable planet must exist, making the player's world precious and the choice to help meaningful.
name: planet_surface
mirror_wall: At least one planet must be habitable (breathable atmosphere, survivable temperature). A system where no planet can support life fails the Mirror — there is no costless escape to another world.
walls: At least one planet must be habitable: breathable atmosphere, 250-320K surface temp, liquid water possible
Inner planets (a < 0.5 AU) must be rocky: high density, thin atmosphere, high surface temp
Outer planets (a > 1.0 AU) must be gaseous or icy: low density, thick atmosphere, cold
Surface gravity must be consistent with planet mass and radius (g = GM/r² within 30%)
Planet radius must be consistent with mass and type (rocky ~0.5-2 R_earth, gas ~2-20 R_earth)
At least one non-habitable planet must exist (the choice to help must have an opportunity cost)
No two planets may have identical biome distributions (each world must feel distinct)

output.format: Per planet: radius, gravity, atmosphere density, temperature range, biome type, habitability flag
output.what_passes: For surface planet: radius, gravity, atmosphere, temperature, biome map reference
